app_store.name: CashPractice
app_store.subtitle: Chart, pay, superbill
app_store.promotional_text: A web chart for one private-pay clinician. Schedule the day, sign the note, record the payment, download a superbill.
app_store.description:
CashPractice is a web chart for one clinician who does not bill insurance.

Open today. Book the session. Write a SOAP, DAP, or free note and sign it. Record cash, a transfer, or a card payment on your own Stripe account. At the end of the month, download a superbill for the dates you choose.

Clients finish intake and consent from a private link. You can export the practice as JSON, CSV, and a note PDF.

Solo is $29 a month or $290 a year. Cancel from settings.

This is a responsive website with a home-screen icon. It is not a native phone app.
app_store.whats_new: Day and week calendar, signed notes, and a downloadable superbill.
